question.problem:
A discrete random variable $X$ has the probability mass function $f(x)$ shown in the table below. Find $\text{E}[{log}_{2}⁡(X)].$

| $x$ | $2$ | $4$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{3}{8}$ |
question.worked_solution:
For a discrete random variable $X$ and a function $r(x),$ the rule of the lazy statistician states that 

$$
\text{E}[r(X)]={\sum }_{x\in S}r(x)f(x).
$$

In our case, we have 

$$
r(x)={log}_{2}⁡x.
$$

 

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[{log}_{2}⁡(X)] & ={\sum }_{x\in S}{log}_{2}⁡(x)\,f(x) \\  & ={log}_{2}⁡(2)\cdot \frac{1}{8}+{log}_{2}⁡(4)\cdot \frac{1}{2}+{log}_{2}⁡(8)\cdot \frac{3}{8} \\  & =1\cdot \frac{1}{8}+2\cdot \frac{1}{2}+3\cdot \frac{3}{8} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+1+\frac{9}{8} \\  & =\frac{18}{8} \\  & =\frac{9}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
